title: WebSocket message envelope fields (open base)
description: Shared envelope fields for every WebSocket message on the terminal/notification connection. Not closed: validate against envelope/message.json, never against this schema alone. The payload is checked by dispatch.json. Unlike the event envelope (contracts/schemas/events/), there is no separate 'append' vs 'stored' variant: WebSocket messages are not persisted; only the events some of them cause are.

type.description: Message type discriminator, e.g. 'terminal.input'. The full enum lives in dispatch.json.

protocol_version.description: WebSocket protocol version for this whole message catalog (not per message type: see contracts/schemas/ws/README.md). v0.1 is 1.

correlation_id.description: Groups related messages (one attempt, one ping/pong round trip) and, where a message reports on a stored event, may echo that event's correlation_id (ADR-0008). Null when not meaningful for this message.

idempotency_key.description: Set by dispatch.json for message types that cause a learner or terminal-bridge event (ADR-0008): resending the same key must not duplicate the effect. Null for message types that do not directly cause a stored event.
